title: Tru Tien Episode 18: The Monarch's Shadow Army
audience: Fans of Korean fantasy, Solo Leveling viewers, action fans, 18-35 demographic
tone: Army showcase, power demonstration, rising threat, legendary army display

concept.hook: Jin-Woo released his shadow army — two hundred strong. S-rank hunters who once laughed now stood in silence. Go Gun-Hee: 'That's not an army. That's an apocalypse.'
concept.story_arc: Jin-Woo decides to reveal his true army → Two hundred shadows rise simultaneously → S-rank hunters arrive and witness → Their reactions range from disbelief to terror → Go Gun-Hee's final assessment: apocalypse
concept.emotion: Decision → Revelation → Disbelief → Growing terror → Final assessment → Humbling silence

Camera: close-up — Jin-Woo's hand with shadow energy flowing, determined expression, raising hand with calm confidence, 'They've been waiting.' 6 seconds.

shots.narration: Two hundred shadows. He had been waiting for the right moment. Today — he stopped waiting.

shots.prompt: Wide shot — S-rank hunters arrive at the training grounds. They stop. Their faces go from confusion to shock to HORROR. 'Two... two hundred?' One hunter falls to his knees. Another vomits. Camera: wide — S-rank hunters arriving, their faces transforming from confusion to horror, one kneeling, another vomiting, absolute shock. 6 seconds.

shots.narration: The five S-rank hunters — who had once laughed at the idea of Jin-Woo needing help — arrived. One fell to his knees. Another vomited. Two hundred shadows.

shots.prompt: Close-up — Go Gun-Hee walks forward alone. His face shows no emotion — but his hands are shaking. He stops before Jin-Woo. 'Your shadow army — how many?' Jin-Woo: 'Two hundred.' Go Gun-Hee: '...' Camera: close-up — Go Gun-Hee's controlled face but shaking hands, walking forward, asking question, Jin-Woo's calm 'Two hundred,' Go Gun-Hee's stunned silence. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Go Gun-Hee's controlled face with shaking hands, walking forward, asking question, Jin-Woo's calm 'Two hundred,' stunned silence, 6s
shots.narration: Go Gun-Hee — who had seen everything — walked forward. His hands were shaking. 'Two hundred.' Jin-Woo confirmed it. And the old man — said nothing.

shots.prompt: Close-up — Go Gun-Hee speaks quietly. 'That's not an army. That's an apocalypse.' He bows deeply. Jin-Woo lowers his hand — the army dissolves. He walks away. Camera: close-up — Go Gun-Hee's quiet 'apocalypse' assessment, deep bow, Jin-Woo lowering hand, army dissolving, walking away alone. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — Go Gun-Hee's quiet 'apocalypse' assessment, deep bow, Jin-Woo walking away alone, army dissolving behind him, 6s
shots.narration: 'That's not an army. That's an apocalypse.' The old man who had led Korea's hunters for thirty years — bowed. Jin-Woo walked away. He had made his point.
shots.sfx: Quiet 'apocalypse,' deep bow, army dissolving, Jin-Woo's footsteps walking away, silence and wind, legendary exit

audio.narration: Two hundred shadows. He had been waiting for the right moment. Today — he stopped waiting. One hundred shadows rose. Then one hundred fifty. The ground shook. Two hundred shadow soldiers — each one stronger than any hunter in Korea. The five S-rank hunters — who had once laughed at the idea of Jin-Woo needing help — arrived. One fell to his knees. Another vomited. Two hundred shadows. Go Gun-Hee — who had seen everything — walked forward. His hands were shaking. 'Two hundred.' Jin-Woo confirmed it. And the old man — said nothing. 'That's not an army. That's an apocalypse.' The old man who had led Korea's hunters for thirty years — bowed. Jin-Woo walked away. He had made his point.
